How prototypes help

A head start, shaped to fit

Each prototype is a working base for its domain. We configure, extend and integrate it so it follows your processes instead of forcing new ones.

  • Walk through it together

    We can show you the relevant prototype using a workflow from your business, not a generic script.

  • Configure, don't rebuild

    Fields, approvals, reports, user roles and branding are adapted for you, which shortens delivery.

  • Connect what you already use

    We integrate with accounting tools, payment gateways, email, WhatsApp and your existing databases through APIs.

  • Supported after launch

    Updates, fixes and new features continue under a support plan, handled by the same team.

Need something none of these cover? See our custom software development service.

FAQ

Frequently asked questions

Are these finished products?

No. They are working prototypes we have built in each domain. We use them to show our approach and as a starting point, then tailor the right one to your business before it goes live.

Can we see a prototype?

Yes. Tell us which one interests you through the contact form, and we'll arrange to walk you through it.

How much can be customised?

Almost everything: fields, workflows, roles, reports, branding and integrations are adapted to how you work.

What if none of them fits?

We also build fully custom software. A prototype is a head start, not a requirement.

Interested in one of these prototypes?

Tell us about your business and which prototype is closest to what you need. We'll explain how we would adapt it.
